source='''def transform(grid):
    # Extend each repeated diagonal color trail by one cell at its open end.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, count in counts.items():
        if color == background or count < 2:
            continue
        points = sorted((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color)
        # The trail direction is determined by its last two cells.
        (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = points[-2:]
        dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
        if abs(dr) != 1 or abs(dc) != 1:

        nr, nc = r2+dr, c2+dc
        if not (0 <= nr < len(grid) and 0 <= nc < len(grid[0])) or grid[nr][nc] != background:

            nr, nc = points[0][0]-dr, points[0][1]-dc
